checks: Positive row summands are absolutely continuous against current inverse volume. Unequal affine restrictions can tie only on a volume-null set of a fiber, so all rows charging a full-dimensional cell have its current continuous gradient. Coincident restrictions contribute one geometric density equal to the sum of their row densities.

The finite coefficient limits separate surviving labels of different limiting directions or with zero limiting gradient. A vanishing source label has inverse mass at most sigma_ij/l_*; bounded current gradients make the weighted classification error vanish in total variation. Multiplication by M_j converts the normalized inverse row density to the geometric original-volume density.

Pushforward by the same rate map and restriction by the same actual cap cannot enlarge the weighted total variation error. Selected row measures are dominated by the product of the cap law and the corresponding full rate-lifted row, so weak limits disintegrate over the single limiting cap law. Taking the common equality first and restricting to Z afterward avoids treating boundary-set restriction as continuous under weak convergence.

The finite-label moment identity from 9b0e9ed78338976f, with chi selecting the oriented direction and multiplying by the gradient length, gives the displayed formula after forgetting rate. Its original-volume normalization and full base-coordinate moments are retained.

The own-cap margin substitution gives strict miss on the own source base only. Over any Borel set of records the formula integrates all matching selected rows against their original cap-law weights, including rows from other groups. It does not identify a source-conditioned diagonal or replace captured defects by the full unselected rows.
Original locator e3baf104c92323ce §6, (12)–(15), supplies the directional aggregate, full-row moments, and exact own-base scope.
